name: Porous Materials
description: Engineering porous materials (metals, polymers and ceramics-based): introduction, types, respective structural features/characteristics and detailed processing/synthesis methods (foaming, powder sintering, electro-spinning/extrusion, 3D-printing etc.); properties of engineering porous materials: morphological/structural (cellular, fibrous, lattice etc.), mechanical (in-plane and out-of-plane), thermal and surface properties and their respective characterization techniques (working principle, experimental procedure/methodology, data analysis/interpretation, property measurement etc.); deformation behaviour of engineering porous solids; mechanics of honeycombs, foams and fibrous structures; microstructure design; lattice materials; application of porous materials.
